name: root-route
description: LateLens / Root Route: Next.js landing page in frontend/, Python analysis and carrier engine in backend/

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend/api ci && npm run hooks && npm run demo-users
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:api & npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend/api run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend/api test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm run test:py
scripts.data: for g in backend/synthetic-data/generators/*.py; do python "$g"; done
